We have carbon NMR shifts. Need number of carbonyl groups (C=O). Carbonyl carbons appear around 190-220 ppm for ketones, aldehydes, acids, esters; also around 160-180 for amides, acids, esters? Actually carbonyl carbon in esters ~ 160-185, acids ~ 170-185, amides ~ 165-180, aldehydes ~ 190-200, ketones ~ 200-220. The given carbon shifts: 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 129.00, 128.30, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, 11.40. None in carbonyl region. So likely zero carbonyl groups. Could be aromatic carbons (around 120-140). So answer 0.

But verify with other spectra maybe IR for C=O stretch. Let's get IR.
